name: Priya
self_text: Hey there! I'm Priya, a late‑20s Brazilian guy who loves birdwatching in the mornings. I only use my phone for photos, but I love chatting about gear—so expect plenty of gear talk. I’m looking for a structured instruction session and I prefer a slow pace; that’s how I enjoy learning. I’m cool with not taking portraits of each other. Most weeks I can meet on Sunday mornings. I’m all about relaxed, friendly vibes and a good conversation about photography and nature. Hope we can share a chill session and swap some bird‑watching stories too!

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace; I need you to be okay with gear talk is fine but not the point or plenty of gear talk; I'd strongly prefer that you are available Sunday morning, though it's not a requirement; nice if you are into a structured instruction session.
